sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
An old note left by the Okami clan, who sought to reach the divine realm.
"A fragrant stone, enshrined in a village within the depths of Ashina. One must throw oneself for it to be found.
With this, the fountainhead fragrance is complete. Let us depart now, to the divine realm."
Given by Kuro after obtaining the Mortal Blade and the Lotus of the Palace.
Provides a clue on the whereabouts of one of the incense ingredients, the Shelter Stone. It is found in the Wedding Cave of Mibu Village, after defeating the Corrupted Monk.
